text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: This gate... It's the strongest power we've encountered so far... The magic in the air is trembling...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このゲート……
今までで一番強い力だね……！
魔力で空気が震えてるよ……！

text_block_list.name: Myu~chan
text_block_list.orig_text:
みゅっ！
みゅみゅ～っ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Myu-chan is feeling the same way. Probably, this gate is the 'right' one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みゅ～ちゃんも同じみたいっ。
たぶん、
このゲートが『当たり』なんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Myu-chan is full of energy too. Let's do our best, Mimi! Little Lyrical~Fight~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みゅ～ちゃんの元気もいっぱいだね～
ミミたちも元気いっぱいでがんばろっ♪
リトルリリカル～
ファイト～！
